stage: Preliminary distinction audit while candidate20 official metrics are still pending; no novelty conclusion.

related_work.title: Noise-Robust Tiny Object Localization with Flows
related_work.review_scope: Abstract, introduction, noise-injection protocol, contributions and page3 visual inspection.
related_work.overlap: Tiny-object annotation sensitivity and uncertainty-guided robust training.
related_work.difference_to_test: Candidate19 drops pairwise order labels that reverse under fixed finite corner perturbations; it does not fit flow error distributions or modify the detector.
related_work.not_established: No evidence yet that partial orders are a new contribution or better than TOLF-related uncertainty supervision.

related_work.title: Bounding Box Regression With Uncertainty for Accurate Object Detection
related_work.review_scope: Abstract, introduction, KL-loss and variance-voting description in extracted text.
related_work.overlap: Ambiguous bounding boxes receive uncertainty-aware treatment; neighboring predictions help localization.
related_work.difference_to_test: Candidate19 predicts scalar action preference using fixed geometry, not a coordinate variance or a variance-weighted vote.
related_work.not_established: Different implementation alone is insufficient; calibrated uncertainty and variance-voting controls have not been evaluated for this candidate.

related_work.title: Relaxed Bounding Boxes for Object Detection
related_work.review_scope: Abstract, introduction, range-based ground truth and RIoU definitions; page3 rendered and visually inspected.
related_work.overlap: A range of possible annotation boxes and relaxed localization losses already exist.
related_work.difference_to_test: Candidate19 retains only a stable subset of within-owner action comparisons, rather than defining a loss to a relaxed box set.
related_work.not_established: Finite sampled corners are neither exact continuous bounds nor a new general uncertainty-set concept. This paper's table-detection application does not by itself make a tiny-object adaptation novel.

related_work.title: RankDetNet / Rank & Sort / Learning to Rank Proposals
related_work.review_scope: Prior project audits and downloaded PDFs; no new exhaustive re-review claimed.
related_work.overlap: Learning ranks of detections/proposals and localization quality is established.
related_work.difference_to_test: Only comparison stability supervision may differ; a small head or ranking objective is not a contribution on its own.

required_before_any_innovation_claim: Official AP/AR benefit over frozen uniform, historical regret and both matched candidate19 controls
A same-count largest-nominal-gap comparison control: stable pair selection may merely select easier or larger-gap comparisons
An expected-perturbed-quality or ordinary jitter-augmentation control to distinguish consistency from generic noise averaging
Mechanism analysis on harms, stable pair coverage and object sizes without oracle deployment
Closer robust ranking and noisy preference learning review; this audit is not an exhaustive novelty search
Independent data or another detection seed before claims of generality
stop_policy: Preserve candidate20 registered official gate. Missing a primary gate is not rescued by these future ablations, another radius, or a different secondary metric.
